entries.back_en: But we had to go! If you're captured by Ludia again, we'll never be able to find Elina.
What does that mean, [name]? Does that mean the [05] we knew never existed?
I can't believe it... I don't want to believe it...
Sorry... Why am I talking about this? We need to think about the village people now...

entries.note: Uses tu form, consistent with Fou-Lu.

entries.back_en: We know you are the Yorae Dragon. You will come with us now.
Do you think... Do you think the monster that appeared in the capital has something to do with the other [04]
I have no 'plan'. I am simply going to meet the general who gave me my commands and will place you under his custody. That's all.
General Rhun is a veteran of many campaigns! It will take more than some monsters to kill him! I'm sure he's waiting for me at Army headquarters.
I don't know how to describe what I feel... My sister...
When we didn't find her at first, people told us to give up... But I still hoped... Then, to hear she's dead...
When [05]... When Deis left me... I don't know how to express it... I felt empty. But...
If I had been in her place... I would have asked you to do the same thing.
What you did... For what it's worth... I think you did the right thing.
entries.note: Uses 'voce' here vs tu elsewhere; minor voice inconsistency but acceptable.

entries.back_en: It just wouldn't feel right to sit around and do nothing.
entries.note: Faithful; 'ficar aqui' for sit around acceptable.

entries.back_en: You're not being nice! Please come help us!
